sets.title: Cracking the Coding Interview
sets.description: An original practice track covering the coding questions of Cracking the Coding Interview, 6th edition, with Python and Java references and hidden edge-case tests. Questions that match a LeetCode problem link to it; the rest are written for this site. This is a private study aid, not a reproduction of the book.

sets.title: Beyond Cracking the Coding Interview
sets.description: Original practice for 232 of the 234 Beyond Cracking the Coding Interview problems, covering chapters 25 to 43 and all 37 problems from the five online chapters: Set & Map Implementations, Monotonic Stacks & Queues, Union-Find, Boundary Thinking, and Booster Problems. Includes Python and Java references and hidden tests. Two book problems requiring additional harness support remain unavailable.

ctci-is-unique.title: Is Unique
ctci-is-unique.hint: Track characters already seen and reject the first repeat.

ctci-check-permutation.title: Check Permutation
ctci-check-permutation.hint: Count each character in one string and subtract the counts from the other.

ctci-urlify.title: URLify
ctci-urlify.hint: Only inspect the meaningful prefix, then replace each space with `%20`.

ctci-one-away.title: One Away
ctci-one-away.hint: Allow at most one replacement, insertion, or deletion while scanning both strings.

ctci-remove-dups.title: Remove Dups
ctci-remove-dups.hint: Walk the list once, keeping a set of values already kept and unlinking repeats.

ctci-kth-to-last.title: Return Kth to Last
ctci-kth-to-last.hint: Advance a lead pointer k nodes, then move both pointers until the lead falls off the list.

ctci-three-in-one.title: Three in One
ctci-three-in-one.hint: Give each stack a fixed slice of one array and track a size per stack.

ctci-stack-of-plates.title: Stack of Plates
ctci-stack-of-plates.hint: Keep a list of bounded stacks; start a new one when the last is full and drop stacks that become empty.
ctci-stack-of-plates.time: O(1) push and pop, O(1) popAt

ctci-sort-stack.title: Sort Stack
ctci-sort-stack.hint: Pop each value and sink it into a second stack, moving larger values back until it fits.

ctci-animal-shelter.title: Animal Shelter
ctci-animal-shelter.hint: Keep one queue per species and stamp each arrival with a counter to compare the oldest of each.

ctci-route-between-nodes.title: Route Between Nodes
ctci-route-between-nodes.hint: Build an adjacency list for the directed edges and search outward from the start node.

ctci-bst-sequences.title: BST Sequences
ctci-bst-sequences.hint: Every sequence starts with the root; interleave each left-subtree sequence with each right-subtree sequence while keeping their internal order.

ctci-insertion.title: Insertion
ctci-insertion.hint: Clear bits i through j of N with a mask, then OR in M shifted left by i.

ctci-binary-to-string.title: Binary to String
ctci-binary-to-string.hint: Double the fraction repeatedly; each time it reaches 1, emit a 1 and subtract 1.

ctci-flip-bit-to-win.title: Flip Bit to Win
ctci-flip-bit-to-win.hint: Track the current run of ones and the run just before the last zero; a single zero between them can be flipped.

ctci-next-number.title: Next Number
ctci-next-number.hint: For the next larger value, flip the rightmost 0 that has 1s to its right and pack the remaining 1s at the bottom.

ctci-conversion.title: Conversion
ctci-conversion.hint: Bits that differ are exactly the 1 bits of a XOR b.

ctci-pairwise-swap.title: Pairwise Swap
ctci-pairwise-swap.hint: Mask the odd bits and shift them right, mask the even bits and shift them left, then combine.

ctci-draw-line.title: Draw Line
ctci-draw-line.hint: Fill whole bytes between the ends directly, then apply partial masks to the first and last bytes.

ctci-triple-step.title: Triple Step
ctci-triple-step.hint: The ways to reach step n are the sum of the ways to reach the three steps below it.

ctci-robot-in-a-grid.title: Robot in a Grid
ctci-robot-in-a-grid.hint: Search from the start, trying right before down, and remember cells already proven to be dead ends.

ctci-magic-index.title: Magic Index
ctci-magic-index.hint: Compare the middle value with its index to skip ranges that cannot hold a magic index, searching the left side first.
ctci-magic-index.time: O(log n) for distinct values, O(n) worst case

ctci-recursive-multiply.title: Recursive Multiply
ctci-recursive-multiply.hint: Recursively multiply by half of the smaller operand, double the result, and add once more when it was odd.

ctci-towers-of-hanoi.title: Towers of Hanoi
ctci-towers-of-hanoi.hint: Move the top n - 1 disks to the spare tower, move the largest disk, then move the n - 1 disks on top of it.

ctci-stack-of-boxes.title: Stack of Boxes
ctci-stack-of-boxes.hint: Sort boxes by height, then compute the tallest stack that has each box at its base.

ctci-boolean-evaluation.title: Boolean Evaluation
ctci-boolean-evaluation.hint: For each operator, combine the true and false counts of its left and right sides; memoize by substring.

ctci-sorted-search-no-size.title: Sorted Search, No Size
ctci-sorted-search-no-size.hint: Double an index until it passes the target or the end of the data, then binary search inside that bound.

ctci-sparse-search.title: Sparse Search
ctci-sparse-search.hint: When the middle is blank, move outward to the nearest non-empty string and compare against that.
ctci-sparse-search.time: O(log n) typical, O(n) worst case

ctci-rank-from-stream.title: Rank from Stream
ctci-rank-from-stream.hint: Maintain prefix counts over values, for example with a Fenwick tree, so both operations are logarithmic.

ctci-peaks-and-valleys.title: Peaks and Valleys
ctci-peaks-and-valleys.hint: Visit every other index and swap the largest of it and its two neighbors into that position.

ctci-multiple-apartments.title: Multiple Apartments
ctci-multiple-apartments.hint: Count rows per tenant in AptTenants, keep counts above one, then join to Tenants for the name.

ctci-open-requests.title: Open Requests
ctci-open-requests.hint: Left join buildings to apartments and open requests so buildings with no open requests still appear with 0.

ctci-close-all-requests.title: Close All Requests
ctci-close-all-requests.hint: Update Requests whose apartment belongs to building 11, found with a subquery on Apartments.

ctci-number-swapper.title: Number Swapper
ctci-number-swapper.hint: a ^= b; b ^= a; a ^= b exchanges the values with no temporary variable.

ctci-word-frequencies.title: Word Frequencies
ctci-word-frequencies.hint: Count every lowercased word once in the constructor so each lookup is a hash map read.
ctci-word-frequencies.time: O(n) build, O(1) average per query

ctci-tic-tac-win.title: Tic Tac Win
ctci-tic-tac-win.hint: A player wins when some row, column, or main diagonal is filled entirely with that player's mark.

ctci-smallest-difference.title: Smallest Difference
ctci-smallest-difference.hint: Sort both arrays and advance the pointer at the smaller value, tracking the closest pair seen.
ctci-smallest-difference.time: O(a log a + b log b)

ctci-number-max.title: Number Max
ctci-number-max.hint: Compute the sign of a - b in a wider type, then use it as a 0 or 1 multiplier to select a or b.

ctci-living-people.title: Living People
ctci-living-people.hint: Add one at each birth year and subtract one the year after each death, then take a running sum.

ctci-diving-board.title: Diving Board
ctci-diving-board.hint: Every board is determined by how many of the k planks are long, from 0 to k.

ctci-master-mind.title: Master Mind
ctci-master-mind.hint: Count exact hits first, then match remaining colors by frequency for pseudo-hits.

ctci-sub-sort.title: Sub Sort
ctci-sub-sort.hint: Scanning left to right, the last value below the running maximum ends the window; scanning right to left, the last value above the running minimum starts it.

ctci-pattern-matching.title: Pattern Matching
ctci-pattern-matching.hint: Choosing the length of the string for the pattern's first letter fixes the other letter's length; check each candidate.

ctci-pond-sizes.title: Pond Sizes
ctci-pond-sizes.hint: Flood fill each unvisited water cell across all eight neighbors and record the size of each component.

ctci-t9.title: T9
ctci-t9.hint: Convert each dictionary word to its keypad digits and keep the words whose digits equal the input.

ctci-sum-swap.title: Sum Swap
ctci-sum-swap.hint: Swapping x from a with y from b balances the sums exactly when x - y is half the difference of the sums.

ctci-langtons-ant.title: Langton's Ant
ctci-langtons-ant.hint: Store only black squares in a set, track the ant's position and heading, and remember the bounding box.

ctci-pairs-with-sum.title: Pairs with Sum
ctci-pairs-with-sum.hint: Count each value; a value v pairs with target - v as many times as the smaller count allows, and with itself half as many times.

ctci-letters-and-numbers.title: Letters and Numbers
ctci-letters-and-numbers.hint: Track letters minus digits as a running balance; equal balances at two positions bound a balanced subarray.

ctci-count-of-twos.title: Count of 2s
ctci-count-of-twos.hint: For each decimal position, count how many numbers up to n have a 2 there using the digits above, at, and below that position.

ctci-baby-names.title: Baby Names
ctci-baby-names.hint: Union each synonym pair, then add every name's count to its group's total.

ctci-kth-multiple.title: Kth Multiple
ctci-kth-multiple.hint: Build the sequence in order; each new value is the smallest of 3, 5, or 7 times an earlier value, with one pointer per factor.

ctci-re-space.title: Re-Space
ctci-re-space.hint: For each starting index, either leave one character unrecognized or consume a dictionary word, and memoize the best result.

ctci-smallest-k.title: Smallest K
ctci-smallest-k.hint: Keep a max-heap of the k smallest values seen so far, replacing its top when a smaller value arrives.

ctci-longest-word.title: Longest Word
ctci-longest-word.hint: Try words from longest to shortest and check whether each splits into two or more other listed words.

ctci-multi-search.title: Multi Search
ctci-multi-search.hint: Insert all small strings into a trie, then walk the trie from every starting position of the big string.

ctci-shortest-supersequence.title: Shortest Supersequence
ctci-shortest-supersequence.hint: Grow a window until it covers every required value, then shrink it from the left while it still covers them.

ctci-missing-two.title: Missing Two
ctci-missing-two.hint: The missing sum s tells you one missing number is at most s / 2; the missing sum within 1..s/2 identifies it.

ctci-max-black-square.title: Max Black Square
ctci-max-black-square.hint: Precompute, for each cell, how many black cells run to the right and downward; then each candidate square is an O(1) check.

ctci-max-submatrix.title: Max Submatrix
ctci-max-submatrix.hint: Fix a top and bottom row, collapse the columns between them into sums, and run Kadane's algorithm on those sums.

bctci-implement-dynamic-array.title: Implement Dynamic Array
bctci-implement-dynamic-array.hint: Store values in a fixed-size array and copy them into one twice as large whenever it fills up.

bctci-extra-dynamic-array-operations.title: Extra Dynamic Array Operations
bctci-extra-dynamic-array-operations.hint: Insertion and removal in the middle shift every later element by one position.
bctci-extra-dynamic-array-operations.time: O(n) for pop(i), insert, contains, and remove

bctci-string-split.title: String Split
bctci-string-split.hint: Walk the string once, cutting a piece every time the delimiter appears and once more at the end.

bctci-string-join.title: String Join
bctci-string-join.hint: Append characters to one buffer and convert it to a string once at the end, so the work stays linear.

bctci-string-matching.title: String Matching
bctci-string-matching.hint: Try each starting position of s and compare t character by character, stopping at the first mismatch.

bctci-palindrome-check.title: Palindrome Check
bctci-palindrome-check.hint: Compare characters from both ends and move inward until the pointers meet.

bctci-smaller-prefixes.title: Smaller Prefixes
bctci-smaller-prefixes.hint: Advance one pointer by one and another by two, keeping the running sum of each prefix.

bctci-array-intersection.title: Array Intersection
bctci-array-intersection.hint: Advance the pointer at the smaller value; when both values match, record it and advance both.

bctci-palindromic-sentence.title: Palindromic Sentence
bctci-palindromic-sentence.hint: Move each pointer past characters that are not letters, then compare the letters case-insensitively.

bctci-reverse-case-match.title: Reverse Case Match
bctci-reverse-case-match.hint: Scan lowercase letters from the left and uppercase letters from the right, comparing each pair case-insensitively.

bctci-merge-two-sorted-arrays.title: Merge Two Sorted Arrays
bctci-merge-two-sorted-arrays.hint: Repeatedly take the smaller front element of the two arrays, then append whatever remains.

bctci-2-sum.title: 2-Sum
bctci-2-sum.pattern: Inward Pointers on a Sorted Array
bctci-2-sum.hint: Start at both ends; if the sum is too large move the right pointer left, otherwise move the left pointer right.

bctci-three-way-merge-without-duplicates.title: Three-Way Merge Without Duplicates
bctci-three-way-merge-without-duplicates.hint: Take the smallest front value among the three arrays and append it only if it differs from the last value appended.

bctci-sort-valley-shaped-array.title: Sort Valley-Shaped Array
bctci-sort-valley-shaped-array.hint: The largest remaining value is always at one of the two ends; place it at the back of the output and move that end inward.

bctci-missing-numbers-in-range.title: Missing Numbers in Range
bctci-missing-numbers-in-range.hint: Step through every value from low to high while advancing a pointer through the sorted array past smaller values.

bctci-interval-intersection.title: Interval Intersection
bctci-interval-intersection.hint: Overlap the current pair of intervals, then move past whichever interval ends first.

bctci-parity-sorting.title: Parity Sorting
bctci-parity-sorting.hint: Move a left pointer past evens and a right pointer past odds, then swap the misplaced pair.

bctci-quicksort-partition.title: Quicksort Partition
bctci-quicksort-partition.hint: Keep boundaries for the smaller and larger regions and scan the unknown middle, swapping each value into place.

bctci-dutch-flag.title: Dutch Flag Problem
bctci-dutch-flag.hint: Grow a red region at the front and a blue region at the back while scanning the unknown middle once.

bctci-prefix-suffix-swap.title: Prefix-Suffix Swap
bctci-prefix-suffix-swap.hint: Reverse the whole array, then reverse the first two thirds and the last third separately.

bctci-shift-word-to-back.title: Shift Word to Back
bctci-shift-word-to-back.hint: Mark the earliest subsequence positions, compact every other letter forward in order, then write the word at the end.

bctci-chess-moves.title: Chess Moves
bctci-chess-moves.hint: List each piece's move directions as row and column offsets; the queen keeps stepping in a direction until it leaves the board or hits an occupied cell.

bctci-queens-reach.title: Queen's Reach
bctci-queens-reach.hint: From every queen, walk each of the eight directions marking cells until the edge or another queen.

bctci-spiral-order.title: Spiral Order
bctci-spiral-order.hint: Walk outward from the center going down, left, up, right, with leg lengths 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, and so on.

bctci-snowprints.title: Snowprints
bctci-snowprints.pattern: Follow the Path Column by Column
bctci-snowprints.hint: Track the fox's row as you move across the columns; it changes by at most one each step.

bctci-valid-sudoku.title: Valid Sudoku
bctci-valid-sudoku.pattern: Seen Sets per Row, Column, and Box
bctci-valid-sudoku.hint: Track which digits appear in each row, column, and 3x3 box, and report the first repeat.

bctci-subgrid-maximums.title: Subgrid Maximums
bctci-subgrid-maximums.hint: A cell's answer is the largest of its own value and the answers of the cells just below and just to the right.

bctci-subgrid-sums.title: Subgrid Sums
bctci-subgrid-sums.hint: Add the answers below and to the right, then subtract the diagonal answer that was counted twice.

bctci-matrix-operations.title: Matrix Operations
bctci-matrix-operations.pattern: Compose Rotations from Transposes and Reflections
bctci-matrix-operations.hint: A clockwise rotation is a transpose followed by a vertical reflection; a counterclockwise rotation is a transpose followed by a horizontal reflection.

bctci-valley-bottom.title: Valley Bottom
bctci-valley-bottom.hint: If the middle value is smaller than the next one, the bottom is at or before the middle; otherwise it is after.

bctci-2-array-2-sum.title: 2-Array 2-Sum
bctci-2-array-2-sum.hint: For each unsorted value, binary search the sorted array for its negation.

bctci-target-count-divisible-by-k.title: Target Count Divisible By K
bctci-target-count-divisible-by-k.hint: Binary search for the first index not less than the target and the first index greater than it; their difference is the count.

bctci-race-overtaking.title: Race Overtaking
bctci-race-overtaking.hint: Binary search for the first second at which player 2 is ahead of player 1.

bctci-search-in-sorted-grid.title: Search In Sorted Grid
bctci-search-in-sorted-grid.pattern: Treat the Grid as One Sorted Array
bctci-search-in-sorted-grid.hint: Map a flat index to its row and column so a single binary search covers the whole grid.

bctci-search-in-huge-array.title: Search In Huge Array
bctci-search-in-huge-array.hint: Double an index until the value there reaches the target or the end of the data, then binary search for the first match.

bctci-water-refilling.title: Water Refilling
bctci-water-refilling.hint: Search for the largest count k with k * b <= a, halving the range with right shifts instead of division.

bctci-tide-aerial-view.title: Tide Aerial View
bctci-tide-aerial-view.hint: The number of flooded cells only grows from picture to picture, so binary search for where it crosses half the area.

bctci-account-sharing-detection.title: Account Sharing Detection
bctci-account-sharing-detection.hint: Map each username to the first IP seen for it; the first repeated username reveals a shared account.

bctci-most-shared-account.title: Most Shared Account
bctci-most-shared-account.hint: Count connections per username, then pick the highest count, breaking ties by first appearance.

bctci-most-frequent-octet.title: Most Frequent Octet
bctci-most-frequent-octet.hint: Count the text before the first dot of each IP and keep the most frequent.

bctci-multi-account-cheating.title: Multi-Account Cheating
bctci-multi-account-cheating.hint: Sort each user's IPs into a canonical key and check whether any key repeats.

bctci-domain-resolver.title: Domain Resolver
bctci-domain-resolver.hint: Keep a map from IP to its domains and another from domain to its set of subdomains.

bctci-find-all-squares.title: Find All Squares
bctci-find-all-squares.hint: Index every value by position, then look up each value's square.

bctci-word-expansion-class.title: Word Expansion Class
bctci-word-expansion-class.hint: Precompute the letter counts of s; a candidate works when its counts exceed them by exactly one letter.

bctci-cheater-detection.title: Cheater Detection
bctci-cheater-detection.hint: Map each desk to its student, then compare each student with the student at the next desk in the same row.

bctci-product-of-alphabetical-sums.title: Product of Alphabetical Sums
bctci-product-of-alphabetical-sums.hint: Alphabetical sums are at most 78, so collect the distinct sums and, for each pair, look up the needed third factor.

bctci-action-log-anomalies.title: Action Log Anomalies
bctci-action-log-anomalies.hint: Track each ticket's history and each agent's last action; a ticket is clean only if its open and close are consecutive actions of one agent.

bctci-largest-set-intersection.title: Largest Set Intersection
bctci-largest-set-intersection.hint: An element survives excluding set i when it appears in every other set, so count how many sets contain each element.

bctci-sorting-by-frequency.title: Sorting by Frequency
bctci-sorting-by-frequency.hint: Count each letter, then sort the distinct letters by descending count and then alphabetically.

bctci-nested-circles.title: Nested Circles
bctci-nested-circles.pattern: Sort by Radius and Check Neighbors
bctci-nested-circles.hint: Sort circles from largest to smallest radius; the set is nested exactly when each circle strictly contains the next one.

bctci-delete-operations.title: Delete Operations
bctci-delete-operations.pattern: Sorted Index Order with a Pointer
bctci-delete-operations.hint: Sort indices by value once; a delete-smallest operation advances a pointer past indices already deleted.

bctci-spreadsheet.title: Spreadsheet
bctci-spreadsheet.hint: Sorting rows by a column reorders whole rows; sorting columns by a row reorders the column indices and rebuilds each row.
bctci-spreadsheet.time: O(rows * cols log(rows * cols)) per sort

bctci-sort-by-publication-year.title: Sort By Publication Year
bctci-sort-by-publication-year.hint: Years fall in a small fixed range, so bucket books by year and read the buckets in order.

bctci-compress-array.title: Compress Array
bctci-compress-array.hint: Push values onto a stack; while the top equals the incoming value, pop it and double the value.

bctci-compress-array-by-k.title: Compress Array By K
bctci-compress-array-by-k.hint: Keep a stack of (value, run length); when a run reaches k, pop it and push the combined value.

bctci-viewer-counter-class.title: Viewer Counter Class
bctci-viewer-counter-class.hint: Keep a queue of join times for each viewer type and drop times that fall out of the window before counting.

bctci-current-url.title: Current URL
bctci-current-url.hint: Push each visited URL; a back action pops entries but never removes the first URL.

bctci-current-url-with-forward.title: Current URL with Forward
bctci-current-url-with-forward.hint: Keep the visited URLs in an array with a current index and a forward limit; a new visit discards the forward history.

bctci-balanced-partition.title: Balanced Partition
bctci-balanced-partition.hint: Track the nesting depth; each time it returns to zero, one balanced piece ends.

bctci-custom-brackets.title: Custom Brackets
bctci-custom-brackets.hint: Push the matching closer for every opener; each closer must match the top of the stack.

bctci-longest-balanced-subsequence.title: Longest Balanced Subsequence
bctci-longest-balanced-subsequence.pattern: Match with a Stack, Drop the Rest
bctci-longest-balanced-subsequence.hint: Match each ')' with the nearest unmatched '(' before it; every character left unmatched must be deleted.

bctci-robot-instructions.title: Robot Instructions
bctci-robot-instructions.hint: The expansion of a suffix starting with '2' is the expansion after it followed by the expansion after the instruction it skips.

bctci-nested-array-sum.title: Nested Array Sum
bctci-nested-array-sum.hint: Add integers directly and recurse into nested lists.

bctci-powers-mod-m.title: Powers Mod M
bctci-powers-mod-m.hint: Compute a^(p/2) mod m once, square it, and multiply by a once more when p is odd.

bctci-lego-castle.title: Lego Castle
bctci-lego-castle.hint: An n-story castle uses two (n - 1)-story castles plus a top row as wide as the whole castle, which is 2^n - 1 blocks.

bctci-laminal-arrays.title: Laminal Arrays
bctci-laminal-arrays.hint: Each recursive call returns its range's total and the best laminal sum inside it; the parent's best is the max of both children's bests and its own total.

bctci-singly-linked-list-design.title: Singly Linked List Design
bctci-singly-linked-list-design.pattern: Head Pointer with a Size Counter
bctci-singly-linked-list-design.hint: Keep head and tail pointers plus a size; removing from the back must walk to the second-to-last node.
bctci-singly-linked-list-design.time: O(1) except pop_back and contains, which are O(n)

bctci-doubly-linked-list-design.title: Doubly Linked List Design
bctci-doubly-linked-list-design.hint: Use head and tail sentinels so every insertion and removal relinks two neighbors without special cases.
bctci-doubly-linked-list-design.time: O(1) except contains, which is O(n)

bctci-linked-list-based-stack.title: Linked-List-Based Stack
bctci-linked-list-based-stack.pattern: Push and Pop at the Head
bctci-linked-list-based-stack.hint: The head of a singly linked list is the top of the stack, so every operation touches only the head.

bctci-linked-list-based-queue.title: Linked-List-Based Queue
bctci-linked-list-based-queue.hint: Enqueue at the tail and dequeue at the head so both ends are reachable in O(1).

bctci-linked-list-copy.title: Linked-List Copy
bctci-linked-list-copy.hint: Walk the original list and append a new node with each value behind a dummy head.

bctci-sublist-reversal.title: Sublist Reversal
bctci-sublist-reversal.hint: Walk to the node before index left, then move each following node to the front of the reversed section.

bctci-linked-list-zip.title: Linked-List Zip
bctci-linked-list-zip.hint: Take one node from each list in turn, and attach whatever remains of the longer list at the end.

bctci-aligned-chain.title: Aligned Chain
bctci-aligned-chain.hint: Each call returns the longest aligned chain starting at its node; an unaligned node returns 0.

bctci-hidden-message.title: Hidden Message
bctci-hidden-message.hint: Recurse into both subtrees and place the node's character before, between, or after them according to its first letter.

bctci-aligned-path.title: Aligned Path
bctci-aligned-path.hint: At each aligned node, a path can join its best aligned chain in the left subtree with its best in the right subtree.

bctci-tree-layout.title: Tree Layout
bctci-tree-layout.hint: Traverse the tree carrying (row, column) and count how many nodes land on each coordinate.

bctci-triangle-count.title: Triangle Count
bctci-triangle-count.hint: A node forms one triangle for each depth that both its all-left descent and its all-right descent reach.

bctci-evaluate-expression-tree.title: Evaluate Expression Tree
bctci-evaluate-expression-tree.hint: Evaluate every child first, then combine the child values with the node's operation.

bctci-left-view.title: Left View
bctci-left-view.hint: Traverse level by level and record the first node you see on each level.

bctci-most-prolific-level.title: Most Prolific Level
bctci-most-prolific-level.hint: A level's prolificness is the size of the next level divided by its own size; compare these ratios level by level.

bctci-zig-zag-order.title: Zig-Zag Order
bctci-zig-zag-order.hint: Collect each level left to right and reverse the odd-depth levels before appending them.

bctci-most-protected-node.title: Most Protected Node
bctci-most-protected-node.hint: A level-order pass gives each node's depth and its position within its level; a post-order pass gives its height.

bctci-bst-search.title: BST Search
bctci-bst-search.hint: Go left when the target is smaller than the node and right when it is larger; stop on a match.

bctci-bst-validation.title: BST Validation
bctci-bst-validation.hint: Pass down the range each node must fall within; a left child tightens the upper bound and a right child the lower bound.

bctci-bst-duplicate-detection.title: BST Duplicate Detection
bctci-bst-duplicate-detection.hint: An in-order traversal of a BST is sorted, so any duplicate shows up as two equal consecutive values.

bctci-bst-kth-element.title: BST Kth Element
bctci-bst-kth-element.hint: Walk the tree in order and stop at the k-th visited node, counting from zero.

bctci-bst-merge-into-array.title: BST Merge Into Array
bctci-bst-merge-into-array.pattern: Two In-Order Traversals and a Merge
bctci-bst-merge-into-array.hint: Read each tree in order into a sorted list, then merge the two sorted lists.

bctci-adjacency-list-validation.title: Adjacency List Validation
bctci-adjacency-list-validation.hint: Collect every directed pair once, rejecting out-of-range nodes, self-loops, and repeats, then check that each pair has its reverse.

bctci-graph-path.title: Graph Path
bctci-graph-path.hint: Search from node1, remember how each node was first reached, and walk those links back from node2.

bctci-tree-check.title: Tree Check
bctci-tree-check.hint: An undirected graph is a tree exactly when it is connected and has V - 1 edges.

bctci-spanning-tree.title: Spanning Tree
bctci-spanning-tree.hint: Every edge along which a traversal first reaches a new node belongs to a spanning tree.

bctci-reachability-queries.title: Reachability Queries
bctci-reachability-queries.hint: Give every node a component label with one traversal per component, then answer each query by comparing labels.

bctci-strongly-connected-graph.title: Strongly Connected Graph
bctci-strongly-connected-graph.hint: The graph is strongly connected when node 0 reaches every node and every node reaches node 0, which is a search on the reversed graph.

bctci-hilliest-connected-component.title: Hilliest Connected Component
bctci-hilliest-connected-component.hint: Traverse each component while summing edge gains and counting edges, remembering that each edge appears twice in an adjacency list.

bctci-highest-average-elevation-gain.title: Highest Average Elevation Gain
bctci-highest-average-elevation-gain.hint: Union the endpoints of every edge, then sum gains and count edges by component root.

bctci-first-time-all-connected.title: First Time All Connected
bctci-first-time-all-connected.hint: Union each cable's endpoints and count successful merges; after V - 1 merges everything is connected.

bctci-shortest-path-queries.title: Shortest-Path Queries
bctci-shortest-path-queries.hint: One breadth-first search from the start records a parent for every reachable node; each query walks parents back.

bctci-graph-hangout.title: Graph Hangout
bctci-graph-hangout.hint: Compute BFS distances from each friend's node, then choose the node minimizing the sum of the three distances.

bctci-days-until-all-infected.title: Days Until All Infected
bctci-days-until-all-infected.hint: Start a breadth-first search from all infected nodes at once; the answer is the largest distance reached.

bctci-count-grid-islands.title: Count Grid Islands
bctci-count-grid-islands.hint: Scan the grid; each unvisited land cell starts a new island, and a flood fill marks the rest of it.

bctci-multi-exit-maze.title: Multi-Exit Maze
bctci-multi-exit-maze.hint: Start a breadth-first search from every exit at once; the first time a cell is reached gives its distance to the nearest exit.

bctci-rgb-distances.title: RGB Distances
bctci-rgb-distances.hint: Run a multi-source BFS from all cells of each color; red cells read the green distances, green cells the blue, and blue cells the red.

bctci-the-floor-is-lava.title: The Floor Is Lava
bctci-the-floor-is-lava.hint: Two pieces are linked when the gap between their rectangles is at most d; search from piece 0 toward the last piece.

bctci-word-ladder-game-variation.title: Word Ladder Game Variation
bctci-word-ladder-game-variation.hint: Track each word together with whether the next move must add or remove a letter, and search that state graph.

bctci-implement-a-heap.title: Implement a Heap
bctci-implement-a-heap.hint: Store the heap in an array; sift a pushed value up and sift the moved last value down after a pop. Heapify from the bottom up.
bctci-implement-a-heap.time: O(log n) push and pop, O(n) heapify

bctci-k-most-played.title: K Most Played
bctci-k-most-played.hint: Keep the k best songs seen so far in a heap whose top is the weakest of them, and replace it when a better song arrives.

bctci-top-songs-class.title: Top Songs Class
bctci-top-songs-class.hint: Maintain a heap holding the best k songs registered so far, so each registration costs O(log k).
bctci-top-songs-class.time: O(log k) per registration, O(k log k) per query

bctci-top-songs-class-with-updates.title: Top Songs Class With Updates
bctci-top-songs-class-with-updates.hint: Keep each song's current total in a map and push a new heap entry on every update; ignore stale entries when reading the top.
bctci-top-songs-class-with-updates.time: O(log n) per registration, O(k log n) per query

bctci-popular-songs-class.title: Popular Songs Class
bctci-popular-songs-class.hint: Keep the lower half of play counts in a max-heap and the upper half in a min-heap so the median is always at the tops.
bctci-popular-songs-class.time: O(log n) per registration, O(1) per query

bctci-most-listened-across-genres.title: Most Listened Across Genres
bctci-most-listened-across-genres.hint: Push the first song of each genre into a max-heap; each time you pop a song, push the next song from the same genre.

bctci-make-playlist.title: Make Playlist
bctci-make-playlist.hint: Repeatedly play a song by the artist with the most songs left, skipping the artist just played; it fails only when that artist is the sole option.

bctci-sum-of-first-k-prime-powers.title: Sum of First K Prime Powers
bctci-sum-of-first-k-prime-powers.hint: Start with each prime in a min-heap; after popping p^e, push p^(e+1).

bctci-most-weekly-sales.title: Most Weekly Sales
bctci-most-weekly-sales.hint: Slide a 7-day window, adding the entering day and subtracting the leaving day.

bctci-most-sales-in-k-days.title: Most Sales in k Days
bctci-most-sales-in-k-days.hint: Track the running k-day sum and the first start where it is largest.

bctci-unique-best-seller-streak.title: Unique Best Seller Streak
bctci-unique-best-seller-streak.hint: Keep counts of titles inside a k-day window and the number of titles that appear more than once.

bctci-enduring-best-seller-streak.title: Enduring Best Seller Streak
bctci-enduring-best-seller-streak.hint: Track the length of the current run of identical titles.

bctci-longest-good-day-streak.title: Longest Good Day Streak
bctci-longest-good-day-streak.hint: Extend the current streak on a good day and reset it on a bad day.

bctci-longest-alternating-sequence.title: Longest Alternating Sequence
bctci-longest-alternating-sequence.hint: Extend the window while each day's type differs from the previous day's, and restart it otherwise.

bctci-maximum-with-at-most-3-bad-days.title: Maximum With at Most 3 Bad Days
bctci-maximum-with-at-most-3-bad-days.hint: Grow the window to the right and shrink it from the left whenever it holds more than 3 bad days.

bctci-ad-campaign-boost.title: Ad Campaign Boost
bctci-ad-campaign-boost.hint: The best run is the longest window containing at most k bad days.

bctci-ad-campaign-with-small-boosts.title: Ad Campaign With Small Boosts
bctci-ad-campaign-with-small-boosts.hint: Treat days below 5 as walls and allow at most k days with 5 to 9 sales inside the window.

bctci-boosting-days-multiple-times.title: Boosting Days Multiple Times
bctci-boosting-days-multiple-times.hint: A window's cost is the total shortfall below 10 of its days; keep the longest window whose cost is at most k.

bctci-longest-period-at-most-k-distinct.title: Longest Period at Most k Distinct
bctci-longest-period-at-most-k-distinct.hint: Keep counts of titles in the window and shrink from the left when there are more than k distinct titles.

bctci-longest-repeated-substring.title: Longest Repeated Substring
bctci-longest-repeated-substring.hint: If some substring of length L repeats, so does one of every shorter length; binary search L and check with a set of windows.
bctci-longest-repeated-substring.time: O(n log n) expected with hashing

bctci-shortest-period-with-over-20-sales.title: Shortest Period With Over 20 Sales
bctci-shortest-period-with-over-20-sales.hint: Grow the window until its sum exceeds 20, then shrink it from the left while it still does, recording the length.

bctci-shortest-with-all-letters.title: Shortest With All Letters
bctci-shortest-with-all-letters.hint: Track how many letters still fall short of their required counts; shrink the window whenever none do.

bctci-smallest-range-with-k-elements.title: Smallest Range With k Elements
bctci-smallest-range-with-k-elements.hint: After sorting, any optimal range spans k consecutive values; slide a window of size k.

bctci-strong-start-and-ending.title: Strong Start and Ending
bctci-strong-start-and-ending.hint: Boosting the edge bad days leaves a middle stretch that must hold the rest; minimize that middle window.

bctci-count-subarrays-with-at-most-k-bad.title: Count Subarrays With at Most k Bad Days
bctci-count-subarrays-with-at-most-k-bad.pattern: Count Windows Ending at Each Day
bctci-count-subarrays-with-at-most-k-bad.hint: For each right end, the valid left ends form a contiguous range; exactly and at-least counts follow from at-most counts.

bctci-count-subarrays-with-exactly-k-bad.title: Count Subarrays With Exactly k Bad Days
bctci-count-subarrays-with-exactly-k-bad.pattern: Count Windows Ending at Each Day
bctci-count-subarrays-with-exactly-k-bad.hint: For each right end, the valid left ends form a contiguous range; exactly and at-least counts follow from at-most counts.

bctci-count-subarrays-with-at-least-k-ba.title: Count Subarrays With at Least k Bad Days
bctci-count-subarrays-with-at-least-k-ba.pattern: Count Windows Ending at Each Day
bctci-count-subarrays-with-at-least-k-ba.hint: For each right end, the valid left ends form a contiguous range; exactly and at-least counts follow from at-most counts.

bctci-count-subarrays-with-good-start-an.title: Count Subarrays With Good Start and Ending
bctci-count-subarrays-with-good-start-an.hint: Any pair of good days, including a day paired with itself, bounds exactly one valid subarray.

bctci-count-subarrays-with-drops.title: Count Subarrays With Drops
bctci-count-subarrays-with-drops.hint: A drop belongs to a subarray when both of its numbers do; count windows with at most k drops and derive the other two counts.

bctci-count-subarrays-with-bad-days-in-r.title: Count Subarrays With Bad Days in Range
bctci-count-subarrays-with-bad-days-in-r.hint: The count with between k1 and k2 bad days is atMost(k2) - atMost(k1 - 1).

bctci-count-subarrays-with-all-remainder.title: Count Subarrays With All Remainders
bctci-count-subarrays-with-all-remainder.hint: For each right end, the subarray is valid for every start up to the smallest of the last positions of remainders 0, 1, and 2.

bctci-count-good-subarrays-with-at-least.title: Count Good Subarrays With at Least k Sales
bctci-count-good-subarrays-with-at-least.hint: Bad days split the array into runs; within a run, for each right end count the starts whose window sum still reaches k.

bctci-max-sum-path.title: Max-Sum Path
bctci-max-sum-path.hint: The best sum reaching a cell is its value plus the better of the best sums reaching the cell above and the cell to the left.

bctci-to-be-or-not-to-be.title: To Be or Not to Be
bctci-to-be-or-not-to-be.hint: Recurse over the words; each word is either kept or dropped, and a complete choice produces one sentence.

bctci-thesaurusly.title: Thesaurusly
bctci-thesaurusly.hint: Walk the words left to right; a word with synonyms branches once per synonym and any other word stays as is.

bctci-jumping-numbers.title: Jumping Numbers
bctci-jumping-numbers.hint: Start from each digit 1 to 9 and append a digit one larger or one smaller while the number stays below n.

bctci-ikea-shopping.title: IKEA Shopping
bctci-ikea-shopping.hint: Try both keeping and skipping each item while tracking the remaining budget, and remember the best rating total.

bctci-count-unique-submultisets-with-sum.title: Count Unique Submultisets with Sum Zero
bctci-count-unique-submultisets-with-sum.pattern: Choose How Many of Each Value
bctci-count-unique-submultisets-with-sum.hint: Group equal values and branch on how many copies of each value to take, so every distinct submultiset is generated exactly once.

bctci-4-directional-max-sum-path.title: 4-Directional Max-Sum Path
bctci-4-directional-max-sum-path.hint: Explore every simple path from the top-left corner with backtracking, recording the sum whenever it reaches the bottom-right corner.

bctci-escape-with-all-clues.title: Escape with All Clues
bctci-escape-with-all-clues.hint: Explore simple paths from the start, stopping a branch once it is no shorter than the best complete path found.

bctci-road-trip.title: Road Trip
bctci-road-trip.pattern: Best Cost Ending with a Stop
bctci-road-trip.hint: The cheapest plan that stops at i costs times[i] plus the cheapest plan ending with a stop among the previous three positions.

bctci-minivan-road-trip.title: Minivan Road Trip
bctci-minivan-road-trip.pattern: Best Cost Ending with a Stop
bctci-minivan-road-trip.hint: The cheapest plan that stops at i costs times[i] plus the cheapest plan whose last stop is within the previous k + 1 positions.

bctci-restaurant-ratings.title: Restaurant Ratings
bctci-restaurant-ratings.hint: The best total up to restaurant i is the better of skipping it or taking it plus the best total up to i - 2.

bctci-count-0-sum-paths.title: Count 0-Sum Paths
bctci-count-0-sum-paths.hint: A zero cell is reached by the paths into the cells above, to the left, and diagonally up-left; a one cell is reached by none that keep the sum 0.

bctci-magic-blackjack.title: Magic Blackjack
bctci-magic-blackjack.hint: The number of busting sequences from a running total depends only on that total, so memoize it.

bctci-minimum-steps-to-one.title: Minimum Steps to One
bctci-minimum-steps-to-one.hint: The fewest steps from x is one more than the best of x - 1, x / 2, and x / 3 when those divisions are exact.

bctci-reconstruct-longest-common-subsequ.title: Reconstruct Longest Common Subsequence
bctci-reconstruct-longest-common-subsequ.pattern: Walk Back Through the LCS Table
bctci-reconstruct-longest-common-subsequ.hint: Fill the usual LCS length table, then walk from the end, taking a character when both strings match there.

bctci-most-non-overlapping-intervals.title: Most Non-Overlapping Intervals
bctci-most-non-overlapping-intervals.hint: Sort by end point and keep each interval that starts after the last kept interval ends.

bctci-time-traveler.title: Time Traveler
bctci-time-traveler.hint: Living through a gap costs its length, so spend the k jumps on the k largest gaps.

bctci-center-assignment.title: Center Assignment
bctci-center-assignment.hint: Sort points by how much closer they are to the first center than the second, and give the first half to the first center.

bctci-minimum-triplet-medians.title: Minimum Triplet Medians
bctci-minimum-triplet-medians.pattern: Pair Small Values with Large Ones
bctci-minimum-triplet-medians.hint: After sorting, each triplet can take two small values and one of the largest values, so the medians are every second value among the smallest two thirds.

bctci-fewest-script-runs.title: Fewest Script Runs
bctci-fewest-script-runs.hint: Sort meetings by end time and run the script at a meeting's end whenever the meeting was not already captured.

bctci-time-traveler-max-year.title: Time Traveler Max Year
bctci-time-traveler-max-year.pattern: Jump the Largest Gaps So Far
bctci-time-traveler-max-year.hint: For each landing point, jump the k largest gaps before it (tracked with a min-heap), then spend any remaining aging budget living forward.

bctci-dag-distances.title: DAG Distances
bctci-dag-distances.hint: Process nodes in topological order; by the time a node is processed, every path into it has been considered.

bctci-dag-longest-path.title: DAG Longest Path
bctci-dag-longest-path.hint: Process nodes in topological order; by the time a node is processed, every path into it has been considered.

bctci-dag-path-reconstruction.title: DAG Path Reconstruction
bctci-dag-path-reconstruction.hint: Record the predecessor that produced each node's best distance, then walk back from the goal.

bctci-counting-paths.title: Counting Paths
bctci-counting-paths.hint: The number of paths to a node is the sum over its predecessors, so propagate counts in topological order.

bctci-parallel-compilation.title: Parallel Compilation
bctci-parallel-compilation.hint: A package finishes at its own compile time plus the latest finish among its imports; compute these in topological order.

bctci-longest-path-of-increasing-degrees.title: Longest Path of Increasing Degrees
bctci-longest-path-of-increasing-degrees.hint: Orient each edge from the lower-degree endpoint to the higher one; the result is a DAG, and nodes sorted by degree are a topological order.

bctci-supersequence.title: Supersequence
bctci-supersequence.hint: Each string forces its letters into order; add an edge between consecutive letters and check that the letter graph has no cycle.

bctci-number-of-palindromic-splits.title: Number of Palindromic Splits
bctci-number-of-palindromic-splits.hint: Precompute which substrings are palindromes; the splits of a prefix sum the splits of every shorter prefix followed by a palindrome.

bctci-channel-views.title: Channel Views
bctci-channel-views.hint: Build prefix sums once; each period's total is a difference of two prefix sums.

bctci-youtube-video-reception.title: YouTube Video Reception
bctci-youtube-video-reception.hint: Mark positive days with 1 and others with 0, then answer each period with prefix sums of those marks.

bctci-exclusive-product.title: Exclusive Product
bctci-exclusive-product.hint: The product excluding index i is the product of everything before it times the product of everything after it, both kept modulo the prime.

bctci-youtube-video-unusual-days.title: YouTube Video Unusual Days
bctci-youtube-video-unusual-days.hint: After sorting the scores, the total distance from one score to all others splits into the part below it and the part above it, each computable from prefix sums.

bctci-longest-subarray-with-sum-k.title: Longest Subarray With Sum K
bctci-longest-subarray-with-sum-k.hint: Remember the first index of each prefix sum; a subarray ending at i sums to k when prefix[i] - k was seen earlier.

bctci-segmented-video-votes.title: Segmented Video Votes
bctci-segmented-video-votes.hint: Add the vote at l and subtract it at r + 1, then a running sum gives each minute's net votes.

bctci-most-booked-slot.title: Most Booked Slot
bctci-most-booked-slot.hint: Apply every bulk booking to a difference array, then scan the running totals for the first maximum.

bctci-all-overbooked-slots.title: All Overbooked Slots
bctci-all-overbooked-slots.hint: Apply every bulk booking to a difference array and count the slots whose running total exceeds the cap.

bctci-hash-set-class.title: Hash Set Class
bctci-hash-set-class.hint: Use separate chaining, grow the bucket array, and track the number of entries.
bctci-hash-set-class.time: Expected amortized O(1) basic operations; O(n log n) sorted enumeration

bctci-hash-set-class-extensions.title: Hash Set Class Extensions
bctci-hash-set-class-extensions.hint: Use separate chaining, grow the bucket array, and track the number of entries.
bctci-hash-set-class-extensions.time: Expected amortized O(1) basic operations; O(n log n) sorted enumeration

bctci-multiset.title: Multiset
bctci-multiset.hint: Use separate chaining, grow the bucket array, and track the number of entries.
bctci-multiset.time: Expected amortized O(1) basic operations; O(n log n) sorted enumeration

bctci-hash-map-class.title: Hash Map Class
bctci-hash-map-class.hint: Use separate chaining, grow the bucket array, and track the number of entries.
bctci-hash-map-class.time: Expected amortized O(1) basic operations; O(n log n) sorted enumeration

bctci-hash-map-class-extensions.title: Hash Map Class Extensions
bctci-hash-map-class-extensions.hint: Use separate chaining, grow the bucket array, and track the number of entries.
bctci-hash-map-class-extensions.time: Expected amortized O(1) basic operations; O(n log n) sorted enumeration

bctci-multimap.title: Multimap
bctci-multimap.hint: Use separate chaining, grow the bucket array, and track the number of entries.
bctci-multimap.time: Expected amortized O(1) add/contains/size; O(k) get/remove for k values

bctci-max-queue.title: Max Queue
bctci-max-queue.hint: Keep a second deque of possible maxima, retaining equal values.

bctci-largest-temperature-change.title: Largest Temperature Change
bctci-largest-temperature-change.hint: Track minimum and maximum indices in monotonic deques.

bctci-longest-stable-period.title: Longest Stable Period
bctci-longest-stable-period.hint: Track minimum and maximum indices in monotonic deques.

bctci-next-greater-element.title: Next Greater Element
bctci-next-greater-element.hint: Resolve pending indices when a strictly taller value arrives.

bctci-largest-rectangle.title: Largest Rectangle
bctci-largest-rectangle.hint: Use increasing heights and compute each popped bar's widest rectangle.

bctci-king-kong-vs-godzilla.title: King Kong Vs Godzilla
bctci-king-kong-vs-godzilla.hint: Find the nearest strictly smaller value on the left and strictly greater value on the right.

bctci-king-kong-vs-godzilla-in-the-fog.title: King Kong Vs Godzilla In The Fog
bctci-king-kong-vs-godzilla-in-the-fog.hint: Find the nearest strictly smaller value on the left and strictly greater value on the right.

bctci-minimum-spanning-tree.title: Minimum Spanning Tree
bctci-minimum-spanning-tree.hint: Process edges by increasing weight and join distinct components.

bctci-mst-reconstruction.title: MST Reconstruction
bctci-mst-reconstruction.hint: Use Kruskal's algorithm with a stable edge ordering.

bctci-edge-in-mst.title: Edge In MST
bctci-edge-in-mst.hint: An edge is mandatory exactly when no alternate endpoint path uses only edges of no greater weight.

bctci-connected-components-over-time.title: Connected Components Over Time
bctci-connected-components-over-time.hint: Sort edge arrivals and advance a union-find structure through the query times.
bctci-connected-components-over-time.time: O(E log E + E alpha(V) + Q)

bctci-largest-connected-component-over-t.title: Largest Connected Component Over Time
bctci-largest-connected-component-over-t.hint: Sort edge arrivals and advance a union-find structure through the query times.
bctci-largest-connected-component-over-t.time: O(E log E + E alpha(V) + Q)

bctci-num-groups-operation.title: Num Groups Operation
bctci-num-groups-operation.hint: Track component minima separately from roots so union by size remains efficient.

bctci-presidential-election.title: Presidential Election
bctci-presidential-election.hint: Use a min-heap and consume every tie at the second-smallest vote count.

bctci-tunnel-depth.title: Tunnel Depth
bctci-tunnel-depth.hint: Connectedness means occupied rows form a prefix, so binary search that boundary.

bctci-3-sum.title: 3-Sum
bctci-3-sum.hint: Sort, fix one position, and search the remaining suffix with two pointers.

bctci-count-substrings-without-letter.title: Count Substrings Without Letter
bctci-count-substrings-without-letter.hint: Each non-a character ends as many valid substrings as the current a-free run length.

bctci-list-of-divisors.title: List of Divisors
bctci-list-of-divisors.hint: Divisors come in pairs around the square root.

bctci-sub-permutations.title: Sub Permutations
bctci-sub-permutations.hint: Slide a frequency window, then deduplicate matching window strings.

bctci-magic-balls.title: Magic Balls
bctci-magic-balls.hint: Separate one-color, two-color, and three-color starting states.

bctci-hiring-and-training.title: Hiring And Training
bctci-hiring-and-training.hint: A run of k-1 hiring days plus training multiplies recruiters by k at a cost of k days.

bctci-interval-xor.title: Interval XOR
bctci-interval-xor.hint: The four endpoints partition the line into pieces with constant membership.

bctci-company-launches.title: Company Launches
bctci-company-launches.hint: Process launch dates in order and retain the two largest previous spends.

bctci-most-ones-with-k-flips.title: Most Ones With K Flips
bctci-most-ones-with-k-flips.hint: Maintain a window containing at most k zeros.

bctci-multiplayer-video-game.title: Multiplayer Video Game
bctci-multiplayer-video-game.hint: Each component of the original visibility graph can be reduced to one survivor by eliminating a spanning tree from its leaves.

bctci-tree-diameter.title: Tree Diameter
bctci-tree-diameter.hint: Process children before parents and combine their heights; use an explicit traversal to avoid recursion limits.

bctci-unrooted-tree-diameter.title: Unrooted Tree Diameter
bctci-unrooted-tree-diameter.hint: A farthest vertex from any start is a diameter endpoint; search again from it.

bctci-longest-alphabet-chain.title: Longest Alphabet Chain
bctci-longest-alphabet-chain.hint: Remove complete alphabet cycles, then find the longest circular run of letters with remaining copies.

bctci-self-doubling-sequence.title: Self-Doubling Sequence
bctci-self-doubling-sequence.hint: Each set bit identifies a round in which the index lies in the incremented half.
